one_line: Sultan of Delhi who fortified his realm against repeated Chagatai Mongol invasions in the early 14th century.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s to early-40s, solid medium-tall build, imposing but not bulky
appearance.face: oval face with a neatly trimmed black beard and moustache, wheatish-medium brown complexion, sharp nose, intense almond-shaped dark eyes, slightly thick brows, default expression calm and calculating with a stern, commanding gaze
appearance.hair: straight black hair reaching just past the nape, mostly hidden under a tall conical steel helmet; the helmet has a rounded point, a slightly flared lower edge, a narrow riveted band at the brow, and a mail aventail covering the sides and back of the head, leaving the face open
appearance.costume: Over a long-sleeved quilted cotton tunic in deep indigo blue that reaches mid-thigh, he wears a sleeveless riveted steel coat-of-plates with small rectangular plates under dull brown leather; beneath is a visible padded lining at the armholes. His legs are covered by loose straight trousers in muted off-white, tucked neatly into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitching. A wide leather belt dyed dark brown with a brass buckle wraps his waist, from which hangs a plain utility pouch. Over the armour, he has a rich but practical woollen shawl in dark green draped from the left shoulder across the chest and back, its narrow border woven with a repeating geometric pattern in gold and red. Light mail sleeves emerge at his wrists, and his hands are gloved in thin brown leather. No crown; his status is signalled by the quality of textiles, subtle gold-thread edging on the tunic collar, and a small polished carnelian ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Indo-Persian sword (early sabre-like tegh) with a steel blade, a simple cross-guard, a dark wood hilt wrapped with brown leather, and a plain brass disc pommel, sheathed in a dark brown scabbard with subtle brass fittings and worn at his left hip.

ref_desc: Alauddin Khalji is a mid-40s, wheatish-complexioned Sultan with an oval bearded face, black hair under a conical steel helmet, wearing indigo quilted tunic, leather coat-of-plates, off-white trousers, dark green shawl, brown boots, and a curved steel sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Alauddin Khalji as a dignified Delhi Sultan in battle attire: a mid-40s man with a wheatish-medium brown oval face, neatly trimmed black beard and moustache, sharp nose, intense dark almond eyes, and slightly thick brows, his straight black hair mostly hidden under a tall conical steel helmet with a rounded point, brow band, and mail aventail covering sides and back of the head while leaving the face open. He wears a long-sleeved quilted cotton tunic in deep indigo blue reaching mid-thigh, over which sits a sleeveless riveted steel coat-of-plates beneath dull brown leather, with the padded lining visible at the armholes and light mail showing at the wrists. His legs are in loose off-white straight trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with simple stitching. A wide dark brown leather belt with a brass buckle encircles his waist, holding a plain pouch and a dark brown scabbard with subtle brass fittings; inside the scabbard is his signature slightly curved Indo-Persian steel sword with simple cross-guard, dark wood hilt wrapped in brown leather, and a brass disc pommel, worn at his left hip. Over his armour, drape a dark green woollen shawl from the left shoulder across his chest and back, edged with a narrow geometric border in gold and red, and add thin brown leather gloves and a small polished carnelian ring on his right hand. Use deep indigo blue, dark green, brown leather, steel grey, and off-white as the dominant colours, and pose him standing firmly, calm and commanding, ready to direct campaigns from behind the lines rather than charging himself.
